title: Mill Creek Business Park BOV
summary: Example Northwest Capital Markets values Mill Creek Business Park at $17,200,000–$18,300,000, most likely $17,800,000, and recommends listing at $18,200,000.

evidence.quote: Prepared by Example Northwest Capital Markets for Model Fund I Mill Creek LLC.
This opinion of value is dated November 2, 2026.
We estimate the market value of Mill Creek Business Park at between $17,200,000 and $18,300,000.
We estimate the market value of Mill Creek Business Park at between $17,200,000 and $18,300,000.
That value is $356 per square foot.
The most likely value reflects a 5.75% cap rate on in-place net operating income.
We recommend a list price of $18,200,000.
Our proposed listing fee is 1.10% of the sale price.
We expect a marketing period of eight weeks from launch to a call for offers.
